content.text:
This is our interpretation of your question:

Which accounts in which ERP make up EBITDA?

content.statement:
WITH __concepts AS (
  SELECT
    formula AS kc_formula,
    group_account AS kc_group_account,
    group_account_name AS kc_group_account_name,
    kpi_name AS kc_kpi_name,
    role AS kc_role,
    source_system_id AS kc_source_system,
    local_accounts AS kcf_local_accounts
  FROM WIPRO_FINANCE_360_APP.APP_DATA.V_ONTO_CONCEPT_CHAIN
)
SELECT
  kc_kpi_name AS kpi_name,
  kc_formula AS formula,
  kc_group_account AS group_account,
  kc_group_account_name AS group_account_name,
  kc_role AS role,
  kc_source_system AS source_system_id,
  SUM(kcf_local_accounts) AS local_accounts
FROM __concepts
WHERE
  kc_kpi_name = 'EBITDA'
GROUP BY
  kc_kpi_name,
  kc_formula,
  kc_group_account,
  kc_group_account_name,
  kc_role,
  kc_source_system
ORDER BY
  group_account,
  source_system_id
 -- Generated by Cortex Analyst (request_id: 00870819-5a8c-421d-bb5b-b112649a0d6b)
;
